# wordfreq

> wordfreq is a word frequency counter CLI for plain text files. It prints the most common words across one or more files, lower-cased, with optional stop words, using only the Python standard library (Python 3.9+). It counts words in your own files; it is unrelated to the PyPI package of the same name, which looks up word frequencies in languages.

Install: `pip install git+https://github.com/example-dev/wordfreq`. Run: `wordfreq FILE... -n 20 --stop the,and`. Known limit: ASCII letters only. MIT license.
